title: Assistant
privacy: Runs on this device. Your plans never leave it; the assistant only reads them to answer you.

status.rulesDetail: Answers from your planned hours. Works everywhere, no download.

webllmDetail.downloadable: Runs a small language model on this device. Needs a one-time download.
webllmDetail.unavailable: This device or browser cannot run the on-device model (it needs WebGPU). Quick answers still work.

optIn.title: Turn on the on-device model
optIn.body: A language model runs on this device, so your plans never leave it. It needs a one-time download of {size}. You can delete it any time in Settings.
optIn.wifi: Use Wi-Fi if you can: the download is large.
optIn.cellular: You seem to be on a mobile connection, and the download is large. Wi-Fi is recommended.

failures.offline: You are offline and the model is not downloaded yet. Connect once to download it.
failures.out-of-memory: This device ran out of memory loading the model. Quick answers are used instead.
failures.device-lost: The graphics device was lost. Quick answers are used instead; reload to try the model again.
failures.invalid-output: The model's reply could not be used. Please try asking in other words.
failures.unavailable: The on-device model is not available here. Quick answers are used instead.
failures.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

settings.needsDownload: The model is not downloaded yet.

proposal.failed: The proposal could not be applied. Nothing was changed.

warning.overlap: Two blocks overlap after these changes.

problem.alreadyThere: "{title}" is already scheduled there at that time. Nothing needs changing.
problem.noChange: I could not turn that into a change to your plan. Try, for example: "Add a one hour Work block on Thursday at 18:00".
problem.needsDetails: I need more detail to make that change: what, which day and what time. Please ask again with those.
problem.unknownCategory: I could not find the category "{category}". Your categories are: {categories}.
problem.unknownBlock: I could not find a block called "{title}" in your plan.
problem.absentDay: "{title}" occurs on {days}. Which occurrence would you like to change?
problem.ambiguousBlock: More than one block matches "{title}". Please say which day it is on.
problem.notDelete: I was not sure you wanted to remove a block, so nothing was changed. Say "delete" or "remove" and the name of the block.

answers.categoryOver: {category}: {planned} planned this week, {amount} over the {goal} limit.
answers.categoryMissing: {category}: {planned} planned this week, {amount} short of the {goal} goal.
answers.categoryNoGoal: {category} has no weekly goal. {planned} planned this week.
answers.minStillNeeded: {category}: {planned} planned, {amount} still needed to reach the {goal} goal.
answers.noNextBlock: No upcoming block in the next week.
answers.noOverflow: All unfinished tasks fit in your free time.
answers.overflow: {count} task(s) do not fit or are late: {titles}. {amount} left unscheduled.
answers.unassigned: {amount} of the week are unassigned ({planned} planned of 168 h).
answers.totalPlanned: {planned} planned this week out of 168 h.
answers.rulesCannotChange: Changing the plan needs the on-device model. Turn it on in Settings, under Assistant.
answers.rulesUnknown: I can tell you the hours of a category this week, what is left to reach a goal, unassigned hours, your next block and which tasks do not fit.
